How to Apply
content_sections.text: Applications must be submitted online on or before 15-10-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of IIMA to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IIMA Research Assistant recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your online application for the Research Assistant position at IIMA is October 15, 2026. It is advisable to apply well before the deadline to avoid any last-minute technical issues.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Research Assistant post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Master's Degree from a recognized institution in fields like Cognitive Neuroscience, Behavioural Finance, Cognitive Science, Neuromarketing, or Behavioural Economics.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available for the Research Assistant position?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy for the Research Assistant position announced by the Indian Institute of Management Ahmedabad.

faq.question: Q4. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application process for the IIMA Research Assistant recruitment is entirely online. Candidates need to visit the official website or the provided application link to submit their forms.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for the Research Assistant role?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for the Research Assistant position?
faq.answer: The selection process primarily involves an application review. Candidates will be shortlisted based on their qualifications and experience as reflected in their applications.

faq.question: Q7. What is the job type for this position?
faq.answer: The Research Assistant position at IIMA is a contractual role, meaning it is offered for a fixed period as per the terms of the contract.

faq.question: Q8. Where is the Indian Institute of Management Ahmedabad located?
faq.answer: The Indian Institute of Management Ahmedabad is located in Ahmedabad, Gujarat.

faq.question: Q9. Can candidates from outside Gujarat apply for this position?
faq.answer: The notification mentions inviting applications from eligible candidates in Gujarat. However, it's always best to check the detailed official notification for any specific domicile requirements.
